title.narrative: Buildling a national strategy to combat wildlife trafficking in Peru: linking sectors and enhancing community participation.

description.narrative: Project activities will 1) produce guidance and recommendations that address key drivers of wildlife product supply and demand, 2) strengthen wildlife traffic law enforcement and monitoring, and 3) fully develop the National Strategy to Combat Wildlife Traffic through systematic analyses of information and lessons learned, and multi-agency and public-private sector cooperation. Specific activities include a) assessing rural Amazonian communities' involvement in wildlife extraction and development of recommendations for public outreach, b) assessinig urban public perceptions about cities' inhabitants' involvement in wildlife trafficking, c) piloting a social media outreach project and draw lessons and recommendations, d) identifying critical wildlife trafficking value chain links and georgraphic areas in Peru through a systematic review and analysis of available information, e) designing a unified database and standar data management protocols, f) identifying key law enforcement interventions, g) evaluating the legal framework and organizational structure to identify opportunities for inter-agency cooperation and create inter-agency cooperation platforms, and h) support government officials in the development of a National Strategy to Combat Wildlife Traffic in Peru.

person-name.narrative: William Jones; Colleen Holland; Julie Rice; Ry
